decision.observation: The goose stands upright just north of the blue can; the bend hint persists. Sequential attempts combining Ctrl+button in one action produced a crouch that immediately released.
decision.hypothesis: The crouch must be established first (Ctrl held alone), then a separate press while still crouched; combining both in one action may cancel the crouch before the press registers.
decision.memory: Controls page: crouch = hold Ctrl (or C), grab = click or Z, honk = Space, flap = X, run = Shift, zoom = A/0 and S.
